name: Kandy Sacred Heritage & Royal Cultural Expedition
destination: Sigiriya, Kandy, Nuwara Eliya, Yala, Galle, Colombo
shortDescription: A premier 10-day private journey across Sigiriya rock fortress, Kandy temples, Ella tea hills, Yala safaris, Galle Fort, and Colombo.
description: Experience the very best of Sri Lanka with our signature private expedition. Starting in the cultural triangle, ascend the Sigiriya rock fortress, wander through royal botanical gardens in Kandy, board the scenic blue train to the highlands, and embark on thrilling game drives in Yala National Park before exploring historic Galle Fort and Colombo city.
highlights: Sigiriya Lion Rock Fortress climb
Temple of the Tooth Relic in Kandy
Scenic Ella Nine Arch Bridge train journey
Big game safari in Yala National Park
UNESCO Galle Dutch Fort walking tour
Colombo City Highlights & Shopping

itinerary.title: Arrival & Coastal Negombo Welcome
itinerary.description: Meet and greet by your private chauffeur at Bandaranaike International Airport (BIA). Transfer to your coastal hotel for rest and orientation.

itinerary.title: Dambulla Golden Cave Temple & Sigiriya
itinerary.description: Journey into the Cultural Triangle. Explore the ancient murals of Dambulla and ascend the world-famous Sigiriya Lion Rock Fortress at sunset.

itinerary.title: Polonnaruwa Ancient Kingdom & Minneriya Safari
itinerary.description: Cycle through ancient ruins of Polonnaruwa, followed by an afternoon open-top 4x4 elephant gathering safari in Minneriya National Park.

itinerary.title: Matale Spice Gardens & Kandy Royal Heritage
itinerary.description: Travel to the hill capital of Kandy. Visit a fragrant spice grove and witness the evening veneration ceremony at the Sacred Temple of the Tooth.

itinerary.title: Highland Tea Plantations & Nuwara Eliya
itinerary.description: Board the iconic highland train winding through misty tea valleys and waterfalls. Visit a colonial tea factory for fresh Ceylon tea tasting.

itinerary.title: Horton Plains & World's End Trekking
itinerary.description: Early morning nature trek across Horton Plains National Park, reaching the dramatic 880-meter precipice at World's End and Baker's Falls.

itinerary.title: Ella Nine Arch Bridge & Little Adam's Peak
itinerary.description: Hike to Little Adam's Peak for 360-degree mountain panoramas and photograph trains passing over the historic Demodara Nine Arch Bridge.

itinerary.title: Yala National Park Big Game Leopard Safari
itinerary.description: Descend to the southern wilderness for dawn and dusk safaris searching for Sri Lankan leopards, sloth bears, and Asian elephants.

itinerary.title: UNESCO Galle Dutch Fort & Southern Beaches
itinerary.description: Walk along the 17th-century ramparts of Galle Fort, discover boutique cafes and artisan workshops, and relax along golden sandy shores.

itinerary.title: Colombo City Highlights & Airport Departure
itinerary.description: Scenic coastal expressway drive to Colombo for sightseeing, Lotus Tower, and last-minute shopping before transfer to BIA for your flight home.

includedServices: Luxury boutique accommodation, private air-conditioned transport with chauffeur-guide, daily breakfast, and entrance tickets.
accommodation: 5-Star luxury boutique hotels and luxury tented safari lodge
transportation: Private Mercedes executive van with dedicated chauffeur-guide
whatToExpect: Moderate walking at cultural sites, comfortable air-conditioned journeys, and warm tropical weather with cooler evenings in Nuwara Eliya.
entryRequirements: Passport valid for minimum 6 months from departure date.
visaInformation: Online ETA tourist visa pre-approval required prior to boarding.

name: Classic Bentota Beach, Culture & Coastline Escape
destination: Colombo, Dambulla, Sigiriya, Kandy, Bentota & Galle
shortDescription: A scenic 7-day tour combining Sigiriya, Kandy cultural monuments, Colombo highlights, and Galle Fort coastline.
description: Explore the UNESCO World Heritage Golden Cave Temple of Dambulla, ascend Sigiriya rock fortress, experience the sacred Temple of the Tooth in Kandy, explore Colombo, and unwind at beachfront luxury resorts near Galle Fort.
highlights: Sigiriya Lion Rock Citadel
Temple of the Tooth in Kandy
Galle Fort colonial ramparts & lighthouse
Colombo City sightseeing
Madu River boat safari in Balapitiya
Water sports in Bentota beach

itinerary.title: Arrival & Cultural Triangle Transfer
itinerary.description: Warm welcome at Colombo BIA airport and comfortable transfer to Dambulla & Sigiriya.

itinerary.title: Sigiriya Rock Fortress & Village Experience
itinerary.description: Climb the ancient rock citadel and enjoy a traditional village catamaran ride and local lunch.

itinerary.title: Royal Botanical Gardens & Kandy Temple of the Tooth
itinerary.description: Explore Peradeniya botanical gardens and the sacred Temple of the Tooth Relic in Kandy.

itinerary.title: Scenic Drive to Bentota & River Boat Safari
itinerary.description: Travel to the southwest coast with an eco boat safari through the mangroves of Madu River.

itinerary.title: Bentota Golden Beach Leisure
itinerary.description: Full day of beach relaxation, Ayurvedic spa treatments, and water sports.

itinerary.title: Day Trip to Galle Fort & Sea Turtle Conservation
itinerary.description: Visit the historic Portuguese and Dutch ramparts of Galle Fort, lighthouse, and a sea turtle sanctuary.

itinerary.title: Colombo City Highlights & Departure
itinerary.description: Sightseeing in the capital city of Colombo followed by airport transfer for your departure.

includedServices: 4-star beachfront resort stays, air-conditioned sedan transfer, daily breakfast.
transportation: Private air-conditioned sedan with professional driver
whatToExpect: Leisurely paced itinerary suitable for families, couples, and relaxed explorers.
entryRequirements: Passport valid for at least 6 months.
visaInformation: Sri Lanka ETA tourist visa assistance provided.

name: Nuwara Eliya Tea Plantations & Highland Scenic Trails
destination: Kandy, Nuwara Eliya, Horton Plains & Ella
shortDescription: Ride the world-famous blue train through misty Ceylon tea valleys, hike Little Adam's Peak, and explore Ella Nine Arch Bridge.
description: Immerse yourself in the emerald mountains of Sri Lanka's central highlands. Experience the legendary scenic train from Kandy to Ella, tour historic colonial tea estates, hike through cloud forests in Horton Plains to World's End, and witness panoramic waterfalls.
highlights: Iconic Kandy-to-Ella scenic mountain train ride
Demodara Nine Arch Bridge sunrise photoshoot
Little Adam's Peak & Ella Rock trekking
Ceylon tea factory tour & private tasting
Horton Plains National Park & World's End
Ramboda and Ravana scenic waterfalls

itinerary.title: Arrival & Transfer to Royal Kandy
itinerary.description: Airport reception and scenic drive through tropical valleys to the hillside city of Kandy.

itinerary.title: Kandy Cultural Sights & Peradeniya Gardens
itinerary.description: Visit the Temple of the Tooth Relic and stroll among orchid houses at Peradeniya Royal Botanic Gardens.

itinerary.title: Scenic Highland Blue Train to Nuwara Eliya
itinerary.description: Board the reserved first-class train winding past waterfalls and tea estates into 'Little England'.

itinerary.title: World's End Trekking & Journey to Ella
itinerary.description: Dawn expedition across Horton Plains plateau, then transfer to the picturesque mountain village of Ella.

itinerary.title: Nine Arch Bridge, Little Adam's Peak & Ravana Falls
itinerary.description: Explore the architectural marvel of Nine Arch Bridge, hike Little Adam's Peak, and swim near Ravana Falls.

itinerary.title: Highland Descent & Departure Transfer
itinerary.description: Scenic descent to Colombo or airport transfer with memories of Sri Lanka's breathtaking misty mountains.

includedServices: Colonial tea bungalows and mountain view boutique hotels, reserved train tickets, private van.
accommodation: Heritage tea bungalows and luxury mountain view suites in Ella
transportation: Private air-conditioned vehicle and scenic train ticket reservations
whatToExpect: Cool highland temperatures, scenic photography opportunities, and gentle mountain hiking.
visaInformation: Online Sri Lanka ETA tourist visa assistance included.

name: Dubai & Abu Dhabi Premium Holiday
shortDescription: Experience world-class architecture, luxury shopping, desert safaris, and Ferrari World.
description: An extraordinary international holiday for Sri Lankan travelers. Marvel at Burj Khalifa, embark on a sunset 4x4 red dune desert safari with BBQ dinner, cruise Dubai Marina on a luxury yacht, and explore Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque.
highlights: Burj Khalifa 124th floor observation deck
Desert 4x4 dune bashing & Bedouin BBQ dinner
Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque private excursion
Dubai Marina luxury yacht cruise

itinerary.title: Arrival in Dubai & Marina Check-in
itinerary.description: Private airport transfer to your luxury Downtown hotel. Evening at leisure.

itinerary.title: Dubai City Tour & Burj Khalifa At The Top
itinerary.description: Tour Dubai Museum, Gold Souk, Palm Jumeirah, and ascend Burj Khalifa 124th floor.

itinerary.title: Premium 4x4 Red Dune Desert Safari
itinerary.description: Afternoon dune bashing, sandboarding, camel rides, and five-star BBQ dinner under the stars.

itinerary.title: Day Excursion to Abu Dhabi & Ferrari World
itinerary.description: Marvel at Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque and experience thrilling rides at Ferrari World.

itinerary.title: Dubai Marina Yacht Cruise & Luxury Shopping
itinerary.description: Morning private yacht cruise followed by shopping at Dubai Mall and the Dubai Fountain show.

itinerary.title: Departure & Return Flight to Sri Lanka
itinerary.description: Airport transfer to Dubai International Airport (DXB) for your return flight.

includedServices: 5-star hotel in Downtown Dubai, all transfers, desert safari, city tour, and tourist visa assistance.
accommodation: 5-Star Downtown luxury hotel with daily breakfast
transportation: Private airport transfers and executive tour vehicles
whatToExpect: Urban luxury, desert adventure, and warm climate with indoor air conditioning.
entryRequirements: Passport valid for 6+ months from travel date.
visaInformation: UAE Tourist Visa processing handled directly by our visa desk.

name: Maldives Paradise Island Villa Retreat
shortDescription: Overwater villa stay with turquoise lagoons, snorkeling with mantas, and all-inclusive dining.
description: Just a short flight from Sri Lanka, indulge in total serenity in an overwater villa. Includes speedboat/seaplane transfers, daily gourmet dining, dolphin cruise, and coral reef snorkeling.
highlights: Overwater private bungalow with direct ocean access
Sunset dolphin cruise
Guided coral reef snorkeling & water sports
All-inclusive gourmet meal plan

itinerary.title: Arrival in Malé & Speedboat/Seaplane Transfer
itinerary.description: Welcome at Velana International Airport and transfer to your luxury island resort.

itinerary.title: Overwater Villa Relaxation & House Reef Snorkeling
itinerary.description: Explore the vibrant house reef with sea turtles, rays, and tropical fish.

itinerary.title: Sunset Dolphin Cruise & Lagoon Water Sports
itinerary.description: Afternoon kayaking and paddleboarding followed by a sunset cruise watching wild spinner dolphins.

itinerary.title: Spa Wellness & Beachside Candlelit Dinner
itinerary.description: Rejuvenating couple's spa treatment and evening private dining by the water's edge.

itinerary.title: Island Farewell & Return Flight to Colombo
itinerary.description: Scenic return transfer to Malé airport for your short flight back to Sri Lanka.

includedServices: Overwater villa, speedboat or seaplane transfers, all meals & beverages, sunset cruise.
whatToExpect: Pure tropical relaxation, world-class marine life, and warm ocean breeze.
visaInformation: Free 30-day tourist visa on arrival for all nationalities with confirmed stay.
